title: Levi's 025 Men's Premium Soft Cotton Solid T-Shirt - Round Neck, Short Sleeves with Side Branding (Pack of 1) Regular Fit

description: Levi’s 025 round-neck T-shirt for men from the 300LS series makes for an ideal, soft, everyday-wear option. This men's T-shirt is designed to give you an effortlessly casual or sporty look for the ultimate fashion statement. The soft fabric keeps you at ease and allows you to go about your day comfortably. The traditional crew neckline and short sleeves make this T-shirt a minimalistic classic. This men's tee comes in a wide range of versatile solid colors. Levi's 300LS series brings you premium garments that make for a superior ready-to-wear option. This fine collection of menswear is made from high-quality materials that offer a soft touch, unrivalled comfort, and a flattering fit. The 300LS series is a foolproof option for a look that is magazine-ready.

aiReviewsSummary.text: Customers find the t-shirt fits well and consider it worth the price. However, the fabric quality receives mixed feedback, with some praising its softness while others find it poor. The color and appearance also get mixed reviews - while some like the look, others say it looks like a vest, and the color fades over time. Moreover, durability is a concern as the shirt fades after a couple of months, and authenticity is questioned as many customers are unsure if it's a real Levi's product.
